digest.component_or_area: capabilities.py tier derivation and gateway provider signing
propositions: A gateway/* provider with no base_url is incorrectly stamped tier first_class instead of best_effort, misrepresenting provenance in a signed verdict.
The tier derivation logic in capabilities.py:307-311 checks only base_url, missing the gateway/* provider family that admits opaque intermediaries.
Gateway providers like gateway/anthropic appear in KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES and are routed through pydantic_ai.providers.infer_provider but bypass the tier best_effort rule.
A gateway run carries endpoint_host: None, failing to name the intermediary in the provenance attestation.
Direct providers without base_url must continue to stamp tier first_class to avoid collateral damage to non-gateway runs.
